title: explainer diagrams/ladder data
description: A vertical stage ladder with optional gate diamonds between rungs — the SDLC 'triage -> ... -> deploy' shape. Validated by lib/includes.mjs's handleDiagram against the same built-ins-only subset lib/schema.mjs interprets — see core/diagrams/ladder/README.md. Cross-references (gates[].after naming an unknown or last stage, a duplicate after) aren't schema-expressible and are checked by render.mjs itself.

title.description: Diagram <title>, for accessibility; falls back to "Ladder".

stages.description: Rungs, top to bottom in array order.

state.description: Defaults to "same" when omitted. Draws the matching shared box class: ex-box ("same"), ex-box-changed ("changed"), or ex-box-new ("new").

panel.description: A contents.json page panels[].key; makes the rung a clickable node.

gates.description: Decision diamonds, each placed on the connector right after one stage.

after.description: A stages[].id; must not be the last stage.

panel.description: A contents.json page panels[].key; makes the gate a clickable node.
